subject: QBR prep: Acme renewal health & exec flag list
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jessica Park <jessica@acme.com>, Tom Li <tom@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep: Acme renewal health & exec flag list

Team — kicking off prep for Acme's QBR (renewal in Oct). I pulled together a working renewal-risk register and a short deck. See attachments. Please review and annotate by EOD Tuesday so I can roll up exec flags for the Friday leadership sync.

High-level ask:
- Sergio: validate technical health notes and current outstanding tickets (slide 3).
- Lauren: populate adoption/usage metrics and call out any feature regressions we should surface.
- Vivek: confirm commercial posture and any in-flight discount/credit conversations.

Current top-line: renewal risk = MED-HIGH (score 7/10) driven by two items: long-standing latency issues on bulk embeddings and procurement delay on SSO cert.

Attachments: [Attachment: Acme_Renewal_Risk_Register_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: QBR_Prep_Deck_Acme_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Notes / quick bullets for reviewers:
- Customer sentiment: cordial but frustrated on throughput at scale; engineering is logged with ongoing investigation (ticket #5421).
- Financial: renewal expected at list but customer is pushing for a 15% discount tied to SLA credits.
- Procurement: waiting on their legal to sign updated DPA (Procurement contact copied).

If you think anything should be escalated into the exec ask (credits, SRE priority, or legal exception), add a 1-line rationale in the risk register under the "ExecAsk" column.

Thanks — Hannah
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Park <jessica@acme.com>, Tom Li <tom@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Acme renewal health & exec flag list

Hannah — quick pass on the tech side. I updated the register with the following (see sheet: TechnicalNotes):
- Ticket #5421: root cause identified as KV cache thrash at sequence > 4k — mitigation planned with a runtime tweak next Wednesday. Probable impact window: 48–72 hrs during rollout.
- New perf regression on bulk-embed job (reported 6/22) correlates with their large batched ingestion (50k docs). We can propose batching + async ingestion as a short-term workaround.

Recommend Exec flag: request SRE priority for the runtime patch during business hours the week of 7/13, and a proactive credit if SLA breach occurs during the patch. I left comments in the ExecAsk column.

Also: I flagged one item as low risk — their test dataset was malformed which inflated error rates; fixed on our side.

— Sergio
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Acme renewal health & exec flag list

On Fri, Jul 2, 2026 at 11:20 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hannah — quick pass on the tech side. I updated the register with the following (see sheet: TechnicalNotes):
> - Ticket #5421: root cause identified as KV cache thrash at sequence > 4k — mitigation planned with a runtime tweak next Wednesday. Probable impact window: 48–72 hrs during rollout.
> - New perf regression on bulk-embed job (reported 6/22) correlates with their large batched ingestion (50k docs). We can propose batching + async ingestion as a short-term workaround.

Thanks — good context. I refreshed the usage slide and added the ARR / seats / monthly token consumption that Acme is currently at (slide 2). Key customer health signals I added to the register:
- Declining daily active integrations (down 12% MoM) tied to the ingest/backfill failures.
- Support CSAT dipped to 3.6 for May (they cited latency and lack of clear remediation ETA).

Executive attention candidates (my suggestions):
1) SLA credit posture: offer a structured credit tied to successful runtime patch (keeps conversation constructive).
2) Fast-track legal: ask legal to prioritize Acme DPA finalization (they're mid-procurement).
3) Product Champion ask: assign a Head of Product briefing to Acme for roadmap visibility on bulk-embedding improvements.

I've added short text for each exec ask in the register and put recommended wording for the QBR slide.

-Lauren
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jessica Park <jessica@acme.com>, Tom Li <tom@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: QBR prep: Acme renewal health & exec flag list — final for leadership

Folks — thanks for the updates. I'm consolidating final asks for Friday's leadership sync. Below is the exec summary I'll present; please reply ASAP if you want edits or to add another concrete ask (deadline: 10:00 PDT Thursday).

Executive summary (to present on Friday):
- Renewal posture: MED-HIGH risk (7/10). Main drivers: latency at scale (bulk embed path) and procurement friction on DPA/SSO.
- Proposed exec asks:
  • SRE priority for runtime patch (week of 7/13) + pre-agreed remediation credit if SLA breach occurs during the rollout. Rationale: reduces risk of repeat incidents and demonstrates accountability. (Requested by Sergio)
  • Legal to expedite DPA signature; consider offering a limited-term addendum to unblock procurement. Rationale: paperwork delay is blocking renewal timeline. (Requested by Lauren)
  • Offer a one-time commercial credit (5–10%) tied to contract renewal and a joint roadmap session with Head of Product. Rationale: balances concession with stronger product engagement. (Commercial lead: Vivek)

Attached: updated risk register + deck. I also added a prioritized "ExecAttention" section in the register with one-line rationales.

Next steps:
- If no objections, I'll convert these into slides and sync with VP Sales and Legal for sign-off.
- Lauren: can you include the ARR impact slide and send final numbers by 7/6 10:00 PDT?
- Vivek: please confirm commercial range (5–10%) and any pre-approval thresholds.

Thanks — I'll be tagging this item for Friday 7/9 leadership agenda under "Customer Renewals".

Hannah
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
